invariant: unknown -> classify -> identify provider/source -> define falsifiable closure condition -> collect evidence -> append-only resolution -> gate -> receipt

gaps.why_open: Git commit objects prove author/committer metadata but do not identify a specific AI/assistant agent responsible for generating or editing historical content.
closure_requires: historical prompt/export/tool trace explicitly naming the agent or provider
or an authenticated execution/audit log linked by timestamp and artifact fingerprint
gaps.forbidden_shortcut: Do not infer agent identity from prose style, vocabulary, filename, or GitHub committer web-flow/GitHub.

gaps.why_open: GitHub REST Events documentation states that event timelines contain only events created within the past 30 days; 2025 PushEvent records are outside that provider window in August 2026.
closure_requires: historical webhook delivery archive
GitHub audit/security export retained from the period
local/Drive/NOVOexport log containing push_id/ref/before/head with verifiable fingerprint
or another contemporaneous provider record

gaps.why_open: Exact 2025 worktree contains 85 paths and a basename of 268 UTF-8 bytes; audited Ubuntu materialization fails with File name too long. Git commit and cristal.sh blob identity remain verified.
closure_requires: path-preserving environment capable of materializing every tracked historical path without rename/omission
successful execution of the unchanged historical script
contemporaneous receipt with stdout/stderr/exit code and resulting CHANGELOG delta

gaps.why_open: Exact-object audit proves marte.dart references assets/utopia_marte.yaml, but historical pubspec.yaml does not declare that asset; source also explicitly labels YAML parsing as placeholder.
closure_requires: identify a later historical commit that declares the asset and implements a real YAML parser, then create a new proof record
or reproduce a historically accurate build/runtime state that already contains those fixes

gaps.why_open: Deterministic scan of 213 tracked UTF-8 text files found 21 lexical matches but zero strong supporting candidates after excluding derived audit/legal material and requiring rare/co-occurring claim terms plus data/receipt/calculation markers.
closure_requires: raw observations/dataset linked to the 30 assets / 10-buy / 10-sell sampling claim
calculation code or notebook
reproducible receipt establishing the stated accuracy/error metrics
independent rerun

gaps.why_open: Commit-level author metadata is not equivalent to intellectual authorship of each line or generation event.
closure_requires: original drafts/prompts/tool outputs with hashes
or granular editing provenance tied to exact line ranges and timestamps

gaps.why_open: Repository chronology can prove internal anteriority but cannot by itself prove worldwide novelty or first occurrence.
closure_requires: claim-by-claim novelty definition
dated patent and non-patent literature search
documented search strings/databases/cutoff dates
human legal/technical review for any patentability conclusion

gaps.why_open: A repository document describing items as patentable or assigning patent-like labels does not establish filing, publication, grant, ownership, or legal scope.
closure_requires: official application/publication/grant identifier
registry source such as INPI/WIPO/USPTO/EPO as applicable
applicant/inventor/status/date match

gaps.why_open: Self-authored market-value ranges are not independent valuation evidence.
closure_requires: defined asset/rights being valued
comparable transactions or defensible income/cost model
assumptions and sensitivity analysis
independent qualified review
